name: Charleston (Charles Town)
coordinate_basis: The infobox coordinate of the Siege of Charleston article (S121): the Neck and the 1780 lines; the town centre lies about 2 km south-southeast. To be read from a modern map.
notes: Today: Charleston. Existed from 1670 (as Charles Town at this site from 1680).

name: Fort Johnson
coordinate_basis: The coordinates ABT gives (S120) for Fort Johnson on James Island.
notes: Today: Fort Johnson (Marine Resources Center). Existed from 1708 as a fort.

name: Fort Sullivan (Fort Moultrie)
coordinate_basis: The coordinate of Fort Moultrie (S121, from NPS).
notes: Today: Fort Moultrie. Begun in early 1776 (Moultrie took command 2 Mar 1776).

name: Fort Charlotte
coordinate_basis: The Fort Charlotte memorial site on the shore of Lake Thurmond (S126); the ruins are under the lake.
notes: Today: Fort Charlotte site (under Lake Thurmond, McCormick County). Completed in 1766.

name: Ninety Six
coordinate_basis: The coordinate of Ninety Six National Historic Site (S121; HMdb 30623, S122).
notes: Today: Ninety Six NHS (the old village lies 2.5 miles south of the present town). A courthouse village in 1775 (about 12 houses, courthouse and jail, per NPS).

name: Esseneca (Seneca Old Town)
coordinate_basis: The HMdb Seneca Town / Fort Rutledge marker near Clemson (S122); the town is under Lake Hartwell.
notes: Today: under Lake Hartwell near Clemson. A Cherokee Lower Town; burned by Williamson in Aug 1776.

name: Tamassee
notes: Today: Tamassee, Oconee County. A Cherokee Lower Town; burned 12 Aug 1776.
